page_text_en:
Sprout!
When spring comes, the shell of the acorn splits open. A tiny root peeks out and pokes down into the soil.
Soon a little green stem with little leaves pushes up and reaches toward the sun. It’s a baby oak tree.
Day by day, the baby tree grows. Its stem, called a trunk, becomes harder. By the end of the summer, it’s as tall as a pencil.
summary_zh: 本页展示了橡子在春天发芽的过程，描述了根钻入泥土、嫩茎破土而出成为橡树苗，并说明橡树苗在夏天逐渐长高，茎变硬成为树干。

page_text_en:
Just like you, a tree needs food to live and grow. But a tree can make its own food!
When a tree basks in the sun, sunlight helps the leaves turn air and water into a sugary food. This food flows through the veins in the leaves to every part of the tree.
summary_zh: 本页解释了树木如何通过光合作用制造自身所需的食物，并说明这种食物通过树叶的脉络输送到树的各个部分。

and Down

A tree gets bigger in
three ways. It grows
up, it grows out, and it
grows down.

1 向上生长: 每年, 树枝和细枝的末端都会抽出嫩芽。这样, 细枝会越长越长, 树会越长越高。
Growing Up: Every year, new shoots push out of the buds at the tips of branches and twigs. This causes the twigs to grow longer—and the tree to grow taller.
2 向外生长: 每年, 树皮包裹下的树干和树枝都会新长一圈。这样, 树干和树枝会越长越粗。

page_text_en:
Up, Out, and Down

A tree gets bigger in three ways. It grows up, it grows out, and it grows down.

Tree's top is called the crown, made of branches.

1 Growing Up: Every year, new shoots push out of the buds at the tips of branches and twigs. This causes the twigs to grow longer—and the tree to grow taller.

2 Growing Out: Every year, a new layer of wood forms underneath the bark of the trunk and branches. This makes the trunk and branches get thicker.

Inside the trunk are many tiny tubes that carry water from the roots to the leaves.

3 Growing Down: Most of a tree's roots are underground. Every year, the roots spread wider and deeper. That's how the tree grows down.

Tree roots help a tree stand firmly on the ground. When strong winds blow, they protect the tree from being blown over.
summary_zh: 本页解释了树木通过向上、向外和向下三种方式生长：向上生长使树变高，向外生长使树干和树枝变粗，向下生长使根系更深入和广泛，配图展示了树的结构和生长过程。

1
Collect some leaves. Try to get leaves of different shapes and sizes.
2
Place the leaf face-down on a table.
3
Put a thin sheet of white paper on top of the leaf.
4
